instruction: Can you add Firefox at the end of the favorite applications list?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding Firefox at the end of favorite apps. Initial state has [thunderbird, vim, chrome], final state should have [thunderbird, vim, chrome, firefox]. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric which checks set equality, not order.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic issue: Instruction requires 'add Firefox at the end' but metric uses set() comparison which ignores order
The metric check_gnome_favorite_apps (basic_os.py:1-14) uses 'set(apps) == set(expected_apps)' which only verifies presence of apps, not their order
This means ['firefox.desktop', 'thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop'] would incorrectly pass even though Firefox is at the beginning, not the end
The evaluator cannot distinguish between Firefox added at the end vs Firefox added at the beginning or middle
Incomplete verification: The 'at the end' requirement is explicitly stated in the instruction but cannot be verified by the evaluator
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace set comparison with list comparison: change 'set(apps) == set(expected_apps)' to 'apps == expected_apps' to preserve order
Or create a new metric that checks if the last element is 'firefox.desktop' while verifying all other apps are present
Or simplify the instruction to 'Add Firefox to favorite applications list' (without 'at the end') to match the set-based verification capability
